name: Kutsuna Sakura
source:
Age at Death: 7

Sakura is one of the ghost girls who possessed [url=/c49917]Chiyako[/url], and the first victim of the "Spirited Away" incident. She was born and raised in a farm village family. Her infinite patience makes her the most dependable of the seven girls. When alive, she could not eat as much as she wanted, because her family was large yet poor, and she would have to restrain her appetite to feed her younger siblings. Hence, food in her range sometimes vanishes into thin air instantly.

[From [url=https://fruitbatfactory.com/7days/#char]official English page[/url]]
